name: world-dashboard
description: Global economic health dashboard from a sound-money perspective, with depression early-warning indicators

scripts.migrate: npm run build && node packages/ingest/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node packages/ingest/dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.ingest: npm run build && node packages/ingest/dist/cli.js ingest
scripts.backfill: npm run build && node packages/ingest/dist/cli.js backfill
scripts.score: npm run build && node packages/ingest/dist/cli.js score
scripts.daily: npm run build && node packages/ingest/dist/cli.js daily
scripts.sources: npm run build && node packages/ingest/dist/cli.js sources
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "node packages/api/dist/server.js" "npm -w @wd/web run dev"
